values.title: How a Passkey App Works: Spring Boot, React, and YubiKey
values.description: Kill the password in your web app. Build WebAuthn registration and authentication with Spring Boot, React, and a real YubiKey.
values.prerequisite: Comfortable with Java backend development and a JavaScript frontend. No prior WebAuthn experience needed.
values.image_alt: A passkey application authenticating a user with a YubiKey
